items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Martin Roman spent time in a concentration camp with Freddy Johnson; both of them were in there together.

ctx.x: The food was good. And the people are... I always thought the people were nice there.

I met a piano player named Martin Roman. He was from Germany. He was Jewish. He was the piano player with a band called Adde(?) Roselander(?). He would support Louis Armstrong.... A bunch of good musicians... I never saw him again. But Martin Roman spent time in a concentration camp with Freddy Johnson; both of them were in there together.
Where did they do that? In Holland or where?
